summary: Named only on the tnlandforms NC tower list (NCT154) with coordinates; no source found gives its history, height, status or access.

evidence.supports: A list of North Carolina lookout towers includes a tower called Sanford, with coordinates.
The North Carolina Forest Service Lee County office is at 1400 Fire Tower Road.
evidence.quote: The Lee County office is located at 1400 Fire Tower Road

evidence.supports: The Lee County office mailing address is in Sanford.

corrections.why: EZ3345 has the form of an NGS survey-mark ID rather than a lookout register number. The list's last column shows 'bm' for entries with no such code. This is an inference from the list, not checked against NGS.

sources.title: N.C. Forest Service Contacts - Lee County

notes_for_editor: Only a list entry is known for this tower; the coordinates come from the list alone. The Forest Service Lee County office is on Fire Tower Road in Sanford (cite 2), but no source ties that road to the lookout, and the story says so. Consider holding this story until a history source is found. The NGS-register correction rests on the code pattern, not on an NGS lookup.
